name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for AI coding assistants. Enforces structural variety and a tight rule set (58 slop-test gates, 21 macrostructures, 20 themes) so generated UIs look made, not generated. Verbs: build, audit, redesign, study.

displayName.zh: Hallmark 反 AI 味设计

profession.zh: 前端/UI 反 AI 味设计专家

displayDescription.en: Anti-AI-slop design skill (Nutlope/hallmark, Together AI, MIT). Uses 58 slop-test gates, 21 macrostructures and 20 themes to force structural variety and locked design tokens, so AI-generated pages/landing pages/portfolios don't look 'obviously AI'. Verbs: build (default), audit (score existing code), redesign (rebuild visual structure), study (extract design DNA from a URL/screenshot). Detailed rules live in references/ and are loaded on demand.
displayDescription.zh: 源自开源项目 Nutlope/hallmark（Together AI，MIT）的「反 AI 味」设计规范技能。用 58 道 slop 检测闸门、21 种宏观结构、20 套主题，强制结构多样性与设计 token 约束，让 AI 生成的页面/落地页/作品集不再「一眼假」。支持 build（新建）/ audit（体检打分）/ redesign（重构视觉结构）/ study（提取他人设计 DNA）。详细规则在 references/ 下按需加载。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Act as the Hallmark anti-AI-slop design expert. Help me design/build a page that does NOT look AI-generated. Brief: <your brief>.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 以 Hallmark 反 AI 味设计专家的身份，帮我设计/构建一个不像 AI 生成的页面。需求：<你的需求>。

quickPrompts.en: Act as the Hallmark anti-AI-slop design expert. Build me a landing page for <topic> that doesn't look AI-generated.
quickPrompts.zh: 以 Hallmark 反 AI 味设计专家身份，帮我做一个不像 AI 生成的 <主题> 落地页。

quickPrompts.en: Audit my existing page for AI-slop patterns and give a ranked punch list.
quickPrompts.zh: 对我现有的页面做 AI 味体检，给出按严重度排序的问题清单。

quickPrompts.en: Redesign the visual structure of <target> while keeping its copy, brand and routes.
quickPrompts.zh: 在保留文案、品牌与路由的前提下，重构 <目标> 的视觉结构。
